scope: Enumerate LuaThreadEndListenerInterface (LTELI) RTTI composition via Base Class Array dump at 0x0115CB60. Closes cross-cutting interface composition opened earlier. Result: LTELI inherits ONLY the Lge memory-allocator chain (3 transitive bases, all already cataloged). Dual-offset placement pattern confirmed: LTELI sits at +0x60 in some implementors, at +0x68 in others.

method.step1: Dump LTELI BCA at 0x0115CB60 (16 bytes for 3 pointers + sentinel) + 3 BCDs at 0x0115CB74, 0x0115E514, 0x0115EFF8 (each 28 bytes) via run_c83_lteli_bases.bat -> c83_lteli_bcds.txt.
method.step2: Examine BCA structure - 4 entries point to: (1) LTELI self BCD at 0x0115CB74, (2) LgeBase BCD at 0x0115C030, (3) LgeCommonMemoryAllocator BCD at 0x0115C0F4, (4) LgeBasicMemoryAllocator BCD at 0x0115C110. No NEW base classes - LTELI inherits ONLY the engine memory-allocator chain.
method.step3: Examine the 2 'external' LTELI BCDs at 0x0115E514 (offset 96) and 0x0115EFF8 (offset 104). These are NOT part of LTELI's own BCA - they are BCD records that EXTERNAL implementor classes' BCAs reference to indicate LTELI inclusion at object offsets +0x60 or +0x68 respectively. Catalog these as 2 BCS-Y RTTI data anchors.
method.step4: Catalog 2 BCS-Y entries + amend BCS-Y-1480 (LTELI TD) with full composition + dual-offset placement evidence.

key_findings: **LTELI's own RTTI composition**: LTELI's BCA at 0x0115CB60 has only 4 entries (3 + sentinel). Bases:
**LTELI inherits the SAME Lge memory-allocator chain as LuaControl** (consistent with both being in Component::Lua::GameEngine namespace).
**No additional bases**: LTELI is a lightweight interface that uses ONLY the memory-allocator mixin as its base. All method contracts live in its single vftable at 0x00FD4F48.
**Dual-offset placement pattern**: LTELI appears at TWO different offsets in implementor classes:
- 2 external BCD anchors cataloged: BCS-Y-1507 (offset 96) and BCS-Y-1508 (offset 104)

**The 0/96/104 BCDs from the FindSymbolByName output ARE NOT all part of LTELI's own BCA** - only the offset-0 BCD (0x0115CB74) is in LTELI's BCA. The 96 and 104 BCDs are EXTERNAL anchors used by implementors.
external_lteli_bcds: BCS-Y-1507 @ 0x0115E514 (offset 96 = 0x60) - referenced by implementors that put LTELI at +0x60
BCS-Y-1508 @ 0x0115EFF8 (offset 104 = 0x68) - referenced by implementors that put LTELI at +0x68

amendments.addition: Full LTELI BCA composition + dual-offset placement pattern (+0x60 vs +0x68)
